claim: Alphabet's total TAC was $45,566 million in 2021 and $48,955 million in 2022, with the TAC rate flat at 22% in both years.
stance_target: prior-period baseline for TAC magnitude trend
quoted_support: TAC | 45,566 | 48,955 ... The TAC rate was 22% in both 2021 and 2022.

claim: Alphabet's FY2022 10-K, like its FY2025 10-K, discloses only a combined TAC dollar figure covering both distribution partners and Google Network partners, never a distribution-partners-only (e.g., Apple-specific) dollar breakout.
stance_target: the idea that Alphabet's SEC filings disclose an Apple-specific or distribution-partner-only TAC dollar figure
scope_conditions: Alphabet 10-K MD&A cost-of-revenues disclosure, at least FY2021-FY2025
quoted_support: The increase in TAC from 2021 to 2022 was due to an increase in TAC paid to distribution partners and to Google Network partners, primarily driven by growth in revenues subject to TAC.

claim: Consolidated TAC grew from $48,955 million (FY2022) to $59,926 million (FY2025), roughly a 22% increase over three years, while the TAC rate compressed from 22% to 20.3% over the same period.
stance_target: three-year trajectory of Google's aggregate distribution-payment magnitude and rate
scope_conditions: Alphabet consolidated, FY2022 vs FY2025, computed from two 10-Ks
